name: init-product-project
description: Turn product ideas into scoped project foundations with business rules, design validation, and evidence-based readiness.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a product brief into a usable project foundation.
interface.longDescription: For designers and builders working with AI: initialize or adapt project foundations, clarify business rules, select a first journey, plan design validation, and define concrete acceptance. Reuse existing documentation and distinguish agreement, specification completeness, and actual evidence.
defaultPrompt: Khởi tạo nền tảng dự án từ ý tưởng của tôi.
Chuẩn bị brief và kế hoạch cho dự án hiện tại.
